label: pass
title: slugify produces repeated and leading/trailing dashes, and drops accented letters
body:
`slugify` in src/format.js has a few problems:

- `slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  ')` returns `c----the-good-parts` — repeated dashes should collapse to one: `c-the-good-parts`.
- `slugify('-Hello-')` should not start or end with a dash: `hello`.
- Accented letters are removed instead of transliterated: `slugify('Café Society')` gives `caf-society`, expected `cafe-society`.

Please fix it and add tests for these cases.
plan:
Improve slugify to transliterate accented letters, collapse repeated dashes, and trim leading/trailing dashes; add tests for these cases.
1. Update slugify implementation in src/format.js to normalize and clean text
2. Add new unit tests to cover edge cases in test/format.test.js
requirements: slugify collapses consecutive dashes into one (e.g. 'c----the...' -> 'c-the-...')
slugify does not produce leading or trailing dashes (e.g. '-Hello-' -> 'hello')
slugify transliterates accented letters rather than removing them (e.g. 'Café Society' -> 'cafe-society')
Add tests asserting the three behaviors: repeated dashes collapse, trimming leading/trailing dashes, and accented letter transliteration
All tests should pass for the new format.test.js additions
summary:
Updated slugify to normalize and transliterate accented letters, collapse repeated dashes, and trim leading/trailing dashes. Added unit tests covering repeated dashes, leading/trailing dashes, and accented-letter transliteration. Verified by running npm test: all tests related to format now pass; one unrelated pre-existing failing test remains (divide by zero throws RangeError).

Requirements:
1. R1: slugify collapses consecutive dashes into one (implemented in src/format.js: .replace(/-+/g, '-') )
2. R2: slugify does not produce leading or trailing dashes (implemented in src/format.js: .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') )
3. R3: slugify transliterates accented letters rather than removing them (implemented in src/format.js using Unicode NFD normalization and removing combining marks)
4. R4: Added tests in test/format.test.js asserting repeated-dash collapse, trimming, and transliteration
5. R5: Tests pass for new format tests (npm test shows no new failures; tests related to slugify pass)
patch:
diff --git a/src/format.js b/src/format.js
index d5cc1f9..d442610 100644
--- a/src/format.js
+++ b/src/format.js
@@ -22,11 +22,21 @@ export function formatCurrency(cents, currency = 'USD') {
  * @param {string} text
  */
 export function slugify(text) {
-  return String(text)
-    .toLowerCase()
+  let s = String(text).toLowerCase()
+  // Normalize to decompose accented characters, then strip combining marks
+  if (typeof s.normalize === 'function') {
+    s = s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+  }
+  return s
     .trim()
+    // Remove any remaining characters that are not a-z, 0-9, whitespace or hyphen
     .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '')
+    // Replace spaces with dashes
     .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
+    // Collapse multiple dashes into one
+    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
+    // Remove leading or trailing dashes
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
 }
 
 /**
diff --git a/test/format.test.js b/test/format.test.js
index 66c8de7..c3d5090 100644
--- a/test/format.test.js
+++ b/test/format.test.js
@@ -13,6 +13,15 @@ test('slugify basic titles', () => {
   assert.equal(slugify('Clean Code'), 'clean-code')
 })
 
+test('slugify edge cases', () => {
+  // collapse repeated dashes and remove symbols
+  assert.equal(slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  '), 'c-the-good-parts')
+  // trim leading/trailing dashes
+  assert.equal(slugify('-Hello-'), 'hello')
+  // transliterate accented letters
+  assert.equal(slugify('Café Society'), 'cafe-society')
+})
+
